decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - 11.2	The application for the retention of a single storey shed in rear garden, within Wellesley Road Conservation Area, as shown on the unnumbered drawing received on 23 September 2005, is recommended for approval as the proposed development would not harm the appearance or character of the Conservation Area or unduly reduce the existing amenity of neighbouring properties. Therefore the proposed development complies with the relevant London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2003 policies; ENV-B.1.1 New Development, ENV-B.2.2 Conservation Areas and H.6.4 Extensions and Alterations, and the Supplementary Planning Guidance (Residential Extension Guidelines).
Condition : 2 - The exterior finish of the rear and side walls of the building hereby permitted shall be clad to match the front elevation of the building.

Condition : 3 - The building hereby permitted shall not be used for carrying out a separate business,  nor shall it be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as 12A Cambridge Road North, Chiswick, London W4 4AA. The building shall at no time be used or occupied as a separate dwelling or for habitation.
description: Retention of single storey shed in rear garden, within Wellesley Road Conservation Area
